name: Timers and Such
description: This paper introduces Timers and Such, a new open source dataset of spoken English commands for common voice control use cases involving numbers. We describe the gap in existing spoken language understanding datasets that Timers and Such fills, the design and creation of the dataset, and experiments with a number of ASR-based and end-to-end baseline models, the code for which has been made available as part of the SpeechBrain toolkit.
evaluation_method: ASR: word error rate (WER); SLU: intent accuracy and slot-filling F1
general_score_metric: WER for ASR; slot F1 and intent accuracy for SLU
reputation: A small, focused open-source dataset released with SpeechBrain; adopted by researchers working on numeric command understanding and voice-control SLU.
notes: Small, domain-specific dataset (spoken English numeric/command phrases). Limited linguistic diversity (English only), focused on number-containing voice commands; results may not generalize to broader ASR/SLU settings. Baselines provided in SpeechBrain.
